description: Email sent to a hospital after they submit an onboarding application, confirming receipt and that the application is under review.

contactName.description: Primary contact person for the hospital

hospitalName.description: Name of the hospital or healthcare group

applicationId.description: Unique identifier for the submitted application

submittedDate.description: Date and time the application was submitted (display-ready)

reviewEta.description: Estimated time to complete the review

additionalNotes.description: Optional extra guidance or requirements during review
additionalNotes.example: A member of our compliance team may request copies of facility accreditation.

portalUrl.description: Link to view the application in the partner portal

documentsUrl.description: Link to upload or update required documents

unsubscribeUrl.description: Link to manage or unsubscribe from notifications

usage: Trigger this email immediately after a hospital submits an onboarding application to acknowledge receipt and set expectations for the review timeline.
